Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuan'an Feng (遠菴僼禪師語錄), in Yuan'an Feng's hall address. Yuan'an Feng is the exact speaker of the appraisal 'the whole body leaked out' immediately after quoting Deshan Xuanjian's claim that his lineage has no phrases and no teaching to give people. Deshan speaks only the embedded quotation; the headword occurs in Yuan'an's following comment.
